The '''Badlands''' were a desolate region in the southern hemisphere of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pamorjal]]. Vaguely ovoid in shape, the badlands were roughly 64,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in size and sited about 400 kilometers from Pamorjal's main settlement, [[Beldon (city)|Beldon]]. The region was devoid of life and consisted of dry, cracked soil covered with small pieces of [[Color/Legends|black]] stone and small, noxious puddles of undrinkable [[Water/Legends|water]]. The region was permeated with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], which radiated out from the center of the badlands and made passing [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users feel uncomfortable.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

The Badlands were created over twenty [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] after a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Pamorjal)|Dark Jedi]] used the powerful [[Dark side artifact/Legends|dark side artifact]] the [[Soulsaber]] to drain all life from the region to enhance his strength in a fight against a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crew of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]'' ventured to the Badlands while hunting the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]].<ref name="Soulsaber" />
